verdict.rationale: OpenCode is itself an AI coding agent, so it fills the MCP client role; serving tools to other agents over MCP is a different product role. The MCP evidence (opencode-docs-4) covers only connecting OpenCode to external MCP servers, which is client-side and not credited here. The `opencode serve` command exposes an HTTP/OpenAPI endpoint, not an MCP server, so nothing shows OpenCode running as an MCP server.
